## Calculus

- **Foundations:**
  - Limits, continuity and sequences: [[sequence-convergence]], [[squeeze-theorem]], [[supremum-infimum]], [[lipschitz-continuity]]
  - Elementary functions (polynomial, exponential, trigonometric, hyperbolic):
    [[calculus-of-simple-functions]]
- **Differentiation (single variable):**
  - Derivative rules: product rule, [[quotient-rule]], [[chain-rule]]
  - [[implicit-differentiation]]
  - Mean value theorem, L'Hôpital's rule
  - Approximation: [[taylor-series]], [[asymptotic-expansion]]
- **Integration (single variable):**
  - [[riemann-integral]], fundamental theorem of calculus
  - Techniques: substitution, integration by parts, partial fractions
  - Improper integrals: [[gaussian-integral]], [[gamma-function]]
  - Differentiating under the integral: [[leibniz-integral-rule]]
  - Beyond Riemann: [[lebesgue-integral]]
- **Sequences and series:**
  - [[geometric-series]]
  - [[power-series]], [[radius-of-convergence]], [[abels-theorem]]
  - Convergence tests, [[convergence-of-functions]]
- **Multivariable differentiation:**
  - Partial derivatives and multi-indices (see [[pde-fundamentals]])
  - [[gradient]] and directional derivatives
  - Derivative matrices: [[jacobian-matrix]], [[hessian-matrix]], [[jacobian-and-hessian]]
  - Multivariable chain rule and implicit function theorem
  - Taylor's theorem in several variables
- **Multivariable integration:**
  - Multiple integrals and Fubini's theorem
  - [[change-of-variables]], [[change-of-variables-formula]] (Jacobians, polar, cylindrical, spherical)
- **Vector calculus:**
  - [[vector-calculus]]
  - Differential operators: [[divergence]], curl, [[laplace-operator]]
  - Line and surface integrals
  - Integral theorems: Green, Stokes, divergence theorem
  - [[vector-calculus-identities]]
- **Optimization:**
  - [[optimization]], critical points and the second derivative test
  - Constrained optimization: [[lagrange-multipliers]]
  - [[convex-function]]
- **Calculus of variations:**
  - [[calculus-of-variations]]
  - [[functional-derivative]]
  - [[euler-lagrange-equation]]
- **Integral transforms:**
  - [[convolution]]
  - [[laplace-transform]], Fourier series and transform

## Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs)

- **Fundamentals:** [[ordinary-differential-equations]]
  - Order, linearity, initial value problems, notation
  - Existence and uniqueness (Picard-Lindelöf), see [[lipschitz-continuity]]
- **First-order ODEs:**
  - Separable equations
  - Linear equations and the [[integrating-factor-method]]
  - Exact equations (equations in full differentials)
  - Homogeneous equations
  - Bernoulli and Riccati equations
  - Qualitative analysis: direction fields, equilibria, stability
- **Higher-order linear ODEs:**
  - Homogeneous equations with constant coefficients (characteristic equation)
  - Inhomogeneous equations: undetermined coefficients, variation of parameters
  - Reduction of order, Wronskian
  - Euler-Cauchy equations
- **Systems of ODEs:**
  - Linear systems with constant coefficients: [[eigenvectors]], matrix exponential
  - Phase plane analysis and stability
- **Further solution methods:**
  - Power series: [[power-series]]
  - Laplace transform: [[laplace-transform]]
  - Green's functions
  - Numerical methods: Euler, Runge-Kutta, see [[finite-difference-methods]]
- **Boundary value problems:**
  - Two-point boundary value problems
  - Sturm-Liouville problems and eigenfunction expansions
- **Related:**
  - Difference equations: [[linear-difference-equations]]
  - Stochastic versions: [[stochastic-differential-equations]]

## Partial Differential Equations (PDEs)

- **Fundamentals:**
  - [[partial-differential-equations|Partial Differential Equations]] (partial derivatives, order, linearity, homogeneity, classification)
  - Well-posedness (existence, uniqueness, stability)
  - Boundaries and Initial Values (Dirichlet, Neumann, Robin)
- **Tools:**
  - [[gradient|Gradient]], [[divergence]], [[laplace-operator]]
  - [[change-of-variables|Change of Variables]]
  - [[gaussian-integral|Gaussian Integral]]
  - Divergence theorem and integration by parts
- **First-order PDEs:**
  - [[pde-characteristics|PDE Characteristics]]
  - [[method-of-characteristics]]
  - [[transport-equation|Transport Equation]]
  - [[quasilinear-partial-differential-equations]] (Burgers' equation, shocks)
  - Nonlinear first-order PDEs: [[hamilton-jacobi-equation]], [[hjb-equation]]
- **Hyperbolic PDEs:**
  - [[wave-equation|Wave Equation]]
  - [[dalemberts-formula|D'Alembert's Formula]]
  - Domain of dependence, energy methods
- **Parabolic PDEs:**
  - [[heat-equation|Heat Equation]] (diffusion, Fick, Fourier, Newton)
  - Heat kernel and maximum principle
  - Applications: [[fokker-planck-equation]], [[kolmogorov-equations]], [[black-scholes-pde-bspde]], [[feynman-kac-formula]]
- **Elliptic PDEs:**
  - [[laplace-equation|Laplace Equation]]
  - Poisson's equation, harmonic functions, mean value property
  - Maximum principle
- **Solution methods:**
  - Separation of variables
  - Fourier series and Fourier transform
  - [[laplace-transform]]
  - Fundamental solutions and Green's functions, [[convolution]]
  - Similarity solutions
  - Duhamel's principle (inhomogeneous equations)
- **Advanced topics:**
  - Weak solutions and Sobolev spaces
  - Viscosity solutions
- **Numerical methods:** [[finite-difference-methods]]
